"You're just running away from the fact 
that you can't win." While everyone was 
shocked by those words, Light Hello's 
heart was also on the verge of breaking.

Worried, I went to check on her, and she 
muttered to herself. Perhaps she just 
wanted to erase the past regrets of not 
winning races and not being able to sing 
in the Winning Live—

Later, Light Hello apologized, saying the 
Grand Live plan had been a mistake. 
However, Mihono Bourbon questioned if it 
really was one.

If it gives her more chances to share her 
feelings, she wants in. Smart Falcon also 
insisted there was something truly 
thrilling about the Grand Live.

Could there be untapped potential in the 
Grand Live that we haven't realized yet? 
Let's continue our activities and explore 
those possibilities.
